title: Fix broken trailer loading and ensure Trailer Modal reliably renders

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the regression where clicking “Watch Trailer” results in the trailer not loading (no playable video shown). Ensure the TrailerModal becomes visible and the YouTube iframe reliably renders on top of all page content.

quotes: There are still issues. Fix them. Trailer isn't loading.

acceptanceCriteria: From both FeaturedRow and ContentGrid, clicking a media item’s trailer action opens a visible modal overlay above the page content.
When a trailer exists, the YouTube player becomes visible and playable within the modal (not audio-only, not hidden behind other layers).
Closing the modal stops playback and no audio continues in the background.
Re-opening the trailer for the same item after closing works reliably (no “stuck” blank state).

requirements.text: Harden the trailer fetch/query flow so transient TMDB failures (timeouts, rate limiting, network errors, invalid key) do not present as a permanent “no trailer” state. Ensure failures surface as an explicit error state in TrailerModal with a working retry action, and that subsequent modal opens re-attempt the fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: If TMDB trailer lookup fails, TrailerModal shows an error message (in English) and a retry button.
Retry triggers a new trailer fetch attempt and updates the modal state accordingly (success/no-trailer/error).
A temporary TMDB failure does not get cached as “no trailer” for future opens of the same media item.

requirements.text: Add development-only diagnostics to pinpoint trailer failures and modal visibility issues without logging sensitive data. Log: modal open/close events, trailer fetch outcome category (success/no-trailer/errorType), and iframe mount/unmount events.
acceptanceCriteria: In development mode, console diagnostics clearly indicate: when the modal opens/closes, whether the trailer query ran, the resulting status (success/no-trailer/error type), and whether the iframe mounted.
In production builds, these diagnostics do not spam logs and do not expose API keys or user identity details.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources are read-only and must be composed).
Respect the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query architecture; do not introduce new frameworks.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (no backend changes are required unless proven necessary for this trailer issue).
nonGoals: Redesigning the app UI beyond what is necessary to make the trailer modal visible and functional.
Adding new media features (recommendations, playlists, social sharing, etc.).
Adding third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
